newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian HPT gets 50 mln mark loan for mobile net.
newsitem.headline: Croatian HPT gets 50 mln mark loan for mobile net.

text.p: Croatia's post and telecoms monopolist HPT said it had got a 50 million German marks loan from Deutsche Bank on Wednesday for expanding a mobile telephone network.
"Mobile telephony is currently among the most profitable services in the world," HPT's deputy director Mladen Sutalo was quoted as saying in a news release.
"This is the best guarantee not only for a return on our investment but also for the company's profitability."
This was the first major loan raised by HPT, which has so far financed all investment projects from its own resources.
It has set up an analogue cellular telephone system in cooperation with Sweden's Ericsson and a GSM network based on the equipment supplied by Siemens.
The loan was guaranteed by the Croatian government, HPT said but it did not mention terms. No company officials were immediately available for further comment. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
